scope: Proposition 3.1 of the manuscript “Three fixed points on the symplectic quadric threefold” (preprints/A-degenerate-counterexample-to-the-critical-number-Arnold-bound-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 347 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 bebf04613245ab3c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 5. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The manifold M is closed, connected, and of real dimension six. For the restricted Fubini–Study form ω, normalized below, the map A[z0 : z1 : z2 : z3 : z4] = [z0 : −z1 : −z2 : −z3 : −z4] is a Hamiltonian involution. Its fixed set is the smooth submanifold F = M ∩ {z0 = 0} ∼ = S2 × S2 . For every q ∈ F, the differential dAq acts as +id on TqF and as −id on a complementary real two-dimensional subspace of TqM.
